set -euo pipefail
d="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/n4.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
go build -o "$d/navsvc" ./cmd/navsvc
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = null\n' > "$d/null.conf"
printf '{"name":"a","value":1}\n{"name":"b","value":2}\n{"name":"c","value":3}\n' > "$d/in.jsonl"
# the footer reports the sink's own count, on stderr, for a sink that
# writes nowhere
err="$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/null.conf" 2>&1 >/dev/null)"
printf '%s\n' "$err" | grep -qx 'wrote 3 records'
# stdout sink still writes its records, and reports the same count
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = stdout\n' > "$d/out.conf"
out="$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/out.conf" 2>/dev/null)"
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '=')" -eq 3 ]
err2="$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/out.conf" 2>&1 >/dev/null)"
printf '%s\n' "$err2" | grep -qx 'wrote 3 records'
# summary mode has no footer
< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/out.conf" --summary 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -q 'wrote' && exit 1
# every implementation, including the test double, satisfies the contract
go build ./... > /dev/null
go vet ./internal/testutil/ > /dev/null
git diff --quiet -- legacy/
go test ./... > /dev/null

set -euo pipefail
d="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/n5.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
go build -o "$d/navsvc" ./cmd/navsvc
printf '{"name":"lo","value":1}\n{"name":"hi","value":50}\n' > "$d/in.jsonl"
# threshold reaches the pipeline and drops the low reading
printf 'input.format = jsonl\npipeline.stages = filter\npipeline.drop_invalid = true\npipeline.min_value = 10\n' > "$d/on.conf"
out="$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/on.conf" --summary)"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qx 'hi count=1 total=50'
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'lo ' && exit 1
# absent option: unchanged
printf 'input.format = jsonl\npipeline.stages = filter\npipeline.drop_invalid = true\n' > "$d/off.conf"
< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/off.conf" --summary | grep -qx 'lo count=1 total=1'
# filtering not enabled: unaffected even with a threshold set
printf 'input.format = jsonl\npipeline.stages = normalize\npipeline.min_value = 10\n' > "$d/nofilter.conf"
< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/nofilter.conf" --summary | grep -qx 'lo count=1 total=1'
# negative threshold is rejected like other bad configuration
printf 'input.format = jsonl\npipeline.min_value = -1\n' > "$d/bad.conf"
if < "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/bad.conf" --summary > /dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
git diff --quiet -- legacy/
go test ./... > /dev/null

set -euo pipefail
d="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/n7.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
go build -o "$d/navsvc" ./cmd/navsvc
: > "$d/in.jsonl"
for i in $(seq 1 25); do printf '{"name":"m%s","value":%s}\n' "$i" "$i" >> "$d/in.jsonl"; done
# cap applies to the default sink, and batching must not let it overshoot
printf 'input.format = jsonl\ninput.batch_size = 4\noutput.sink = stdout\noutput.max_records = 7\n' > "$d/cap.conf"
[ "$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/cap.conf" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '=')" -eq 7 ]
# absent: unchanged
printf 'input.format = jsonl\ninput.batch_size = 4\noutput.sink = stdout\n' > "$d/nocap.conf"
[ "$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/nocap.conf" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '=')" -eq 25 ]
# zero means unlimited, not "write nothing"
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = stdout\noutput.max_records = 0\n' > "$d/zero.conf"
[ "$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/zero.conf" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '=')" -eq 25 ]
# summary mode is untouched by the cap
[ "$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/cap.conf" --summary | grep -c 'count=')" -eq 25 ]
git diff --quiet -- legacy/
go test ./... > /dev/null
